verdict.rationale: Separate handling of service of process versus ordinary mail is a core question for a registered-agent provider, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party documentation: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt and nothing was fetched. The only community item comments on the company's SEO, not on how legal papers or mail are handled.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider documents how service of legal papers is handled separately from ordinary mail, with distinct delivery commitments
